description: Free-text search across component names, descriptions, intents (what each component is for), attributes, slots, events, example labels and, for a query about icons or one that is an icon name, icon names. Use it to find the component for a UI need, worded as a requirement or a widget name ("let users turn a setting on or off", "dropdown", "avatar with status", "arrow icon").
name: search_components
title: Search components
